manifest.description: High-level syringe dispense action for the 7-head ESP32 syringe tool.

inputs.label: ESP32 Port
inputs.description: Serial device path for the connected ESP32 syringe board.

inputs.label: Calibration File
inputs.description: Calibration file used to convert dispense amounts into syringe motor steps.

inputs.label: Dispense Speed
inputs.description: Optional syringe speed to apply on the ESP32 before dispensing.

inputs.label: Head A
inputs.description: Requested dispense amount for syringe head A.

inputs.label: Head B
inputs.description: Requested dispense amount for syringe head B.

inputs.label: Head C
inputs.description: Requested dispense amount for syringe head C.

inputs.label: Head D
inputs.description: Requested dispense amount for syringe head D.

inputs.label: Head E
inputs.description: Requested dispense amount for syringe head E.

inputs.label: Head F
inputs.description: Requested dispense amount for syringe head F.

inputs.label: Head G
inputs.description: Requested dispense amount for syringe head G.

outputs.label: Status
outputs.description: High-level status for the dispense request.

outputs.label: Controller Reply
outputs.description: Raw serial reply returned by the ESP32 firmware.

advanced_builder_inputs.label: Steps Per Revolution
advanced_builder_inputs.description: Motor steps per full revolution used in the firmware.

advanced_builder_inputs.label: Default RPM
advanced_builder_inputs.description: Default RPM used when no speed override is sent from the workflow.

advanced_builder_inputs.label: Microsteps
advanced_builder_inputs.description: Default microstep configuration passed to the A4988 driver.

advanced_builder_inputs.label: Step Pins
advanced_builder_inputs.description: Comma-separated GPIO pins for the seven step pins.

advanced_builder_inputs.label: Direction Pins
advanced_builder_inputs.description: Comma-separated GPIO pins for the seven direction pins.

advanced_builder_inputs.label: Direction Signs
advanced_builder_inputs.description: Comma-separated direction multipliers for the seven syringes.

notes: Basic runtime inputs are written to the workflow block. Advanced builder inputs describe firmware-level tuning and pin mapping.
